observation_summary: The application throws a NullPointerException when a null value is provided within the replacement array in the StringUtils.replaceEach method.
reasoning_summary: The code attempted to access the length property of a string within the 'replacementList' array without verifying if the element was null. When a null value was present in the replacement array, the call to 'replacementList[i].length()' triggered a NullPointerException. The fix introduces a null check to skip processing for any null entries in either the search or replacement arrays, ensuring the method is null-safe as intended.
